tools.name: check_fibre_availability
tools.description: Check which fibre and broadband deals are available at a UK postcode (or exact address via UPRN/UDPRN) using fibrecompare.com. tools.name: search
tools.description: Compatibility tool for clients that require search/fetch (e.g. ChatGPT deep research). Prefer check_fibre_availability. Searches fibrecompare.com for broadband deals available at a UK postcode contained in the query; returns deal ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Compatibility tool paired with search. Retrieves the full details of one broadband deal returned by search, by its id.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
